work.title: Miqra according to the Mesorah
work.creator: Seth (Avi) Kadish
work.description: Miqra `al pi ha-Mesorah is an edition of the Tanakh in digital online format, available as a carefully corrected draft of the entire Tanakh. It is based on the Aleppo Codex and related manuscripts, and consults the full range of masoretic scholarship.
